alternatives.transcript: I woke up at eight. I had breakfast. I ate bread and coffee. After that, I went to work. I work in an office. My job is okay. I like my colleagues. At lunch, I ate a sandwich. In the afternoon, I had a meeting. The meeting was long. I was tired. After work, I went home. I watched TV. I ate dinner with my family. We talked a little, then I went to sleep. It was a normal day. I don't have plans for this weekend. Maybe I will go to the park. The weather is good. I like it when it's sunny. Tomorrow, I have work again.
